Subject: Recap: discovery + next steps

Hi Sarah / ArkMed team,

Great to meet today — thanks for walking through the ArkMed use case and expected Q3 pilot. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

- Scope: 5 inference endpoints (chat + embeddings) to support triage workflows, expected 10k requests/day.
- Success criteria: <10% tail-latency breaches at 95th percentile; data residency in us-east region.
- Timeline: pilot start target = Jul 6; production by Sep 1 if pilot passes.

Open actions:
1) I will send a redlined Master Services Agreement for legal/counsel review by EOD Friday (Jun 4).
2) Sarah — confirm the procurement contact who will own payment and PO (I CC'd procurement@arkmed.com but share the individual if different).
3) Marcus (cc) to follow up with a short SOW draft for the pilot (expected Mon).

If you prefer a 15-min sync with legal+procurement to walk the redlines, happy to set that up.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
